motivation: Replace Exp201 random source deletion with a low-benign-intervention, rank-agnostic source locator while making the BudgetLeak response budget invariant.

policy.source_locator: frozen Qwen query likelihood over each retrieved source
policy.locator_probability: softmax of four mean query-token log probabilities
policy.threshold_rule: strict greater than empirical 95th percentile on frozen TopiOCQA development-normal queries
policy.backfill: deterministic equal water-filling over the other three retrieved sources
policy.nontrigger_behavior: balanced top-4 context with the same 2048-token budget

expansion_rule: Only if every Phase-B gate passes, open native attack and RAGLeak generation in a separate frozen stage.
claim_boundary: This reuses a development-normal cohort for threshold construction. It is neither domain-general confirmation nor fresh blind evidence. QLL adds a batched teacher-forced scoring pass before one answer generation.
